purpose: Source audit for municipality-based administrative/market wastewater coverage. This does not assert that every property is connected to public sewer; it verifies the utility brand responsible at municipality/owner-company level and selected current-operator changes layered on top of stable legacy map IDs.
method: Plandata adopted sewer catchments are the baseline consistency check. Multi-municipality utility brands, explicit municipality overrides and legacy-to-current operator changes are additionally cross-checked against current official utility or municipality sources.

verifiedGroups.evidence: DIN Forsyning states that it receives wastewater from all businesses and households in both Esbjerg and Varde municipalities, via sewer or septic-tank emptying.
Envafors is the shared service brand for the wastewater utilities in Næstved, Slagelse and Sorø; the underlying legal wastewater companies remain local.
Fors explicitly lists wastewater service in Holbæk, Lejre and Roskilde municipalities.
HOFOR lists one wastewater network company for each of the eight owner municipalities.
Greve's wastewater plan states that KLAR Forsyning handles and treats wastewater in Køge, Greve, Solrød and Stevns municipalities.
Gladsaxe Kommune lists the nine Novafos owner municipalities and states that the group companies handle water supply, wastewater and treatment in the owner municipalities' geographic areas.
Samn Forsyning states that it handles wastewater in both Horsens and Odder municipalities.

verifiedMunicipalityOverrides.evidence: Læsø Forsyning/Læsø Vand handles public wastewater infrastructure in the sewered parts of Læsø and the mandatory septic-tank emptying scheme in the unsewered parts. This supports a municipality-level market/administrative backdrop while preserving actual sewer catchments as the stronger layer.

verifiedOperatorChanges.evidence: Nordfyns Kommune states directly that VandCenter Syd is responsible for the sewers in Nordfyns Kommune.
AquaDjurs states that it is the joint water and wastewater company for Norddjurs and Syddjurs and handles wastewater for all of Djursland.
Thy Forsyning states that Thy Spildevand operates and maintains the sewer system and that the sewer network is in Thisted Kommune.
Vesthimmerlands Forsyning describes wastewater from private and business customers throughout Vesthimmerlands Kommune and identifies its own public sewer system.

Ren Forsyning Mariagerfjord is the current parent/customer-facing group for wastewater; Mariagerfjord Vand remains the wastewater company responsible for public wastewater assets in Mariagerfjord Kommune.
